name: 2.9.4 - Open on another PC
notes: Open on another PC: when the phone opens, changes or prints a Repair Order that is open on another PC, the helper presses OK on COSTAR's Document Already Open and tells the phone, so it can go straight on with another one. The Tempe Orders page's orders no longer pause over a moment of COSTAR's (a stop before Add new is tried again, up to 5 tries). Includes 2.9.3. Update the RDP helper and the desk PC.
